# Daily Report — 2026-09-20

## Task Completed
Added `list_user_sessions` and `get_user_session` tools targeting the `sys_user_session` table.
`list_user_sessions` supports filtering by user (sys_id or user_name auto-resolved), IP address (exact match),
and `logged_in_after` datetime threshold, with `has_more`/`next_offset` pagination.
`get_user_session` retrieves a single session record by sys_id with 404 and empty-result guards.
Both tools are registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
